title: Flow Preview Wire Bezier
description: The preview wire for connection should use the same bezier curve as committed edges, not a straight line. Must work in both directions (drag from source or target port).
summary: Connection preview wires now use the same cubic-bezier curve as committed edges. `RenderSnapshot.pending_edge` carries a `CubicBez` computed in `GraphEngine::draw_edge_preview_curve` with proper anchor node centers for source-anchored, target-anchored, and reconnect drags. DAG paint uses the curve directly instead of recomputing with identical endpoints as centers (which produced a straight line).
